En: “I got the firmware you asked me to extract from them. I left it where you told me to, however
I’ve noticed that the compiled code is exactly the same for all of them, but they don’t act the same offstage.
For example, the [uniform]end03bn.10.21[/uniform], the one inside the bonnie suit, tends to roam the arcade
while the [uniform]end02ch.10.21[/uniform], the one in chica, really seems to really like the kitchen.
When I was in the afternoon shift, last week, it was imposible to send her back to the stage.
Looking at the promotional posters, I guess this behavior is intended, but I couldn’t tell without the source code.
I saw more electronics in the suits themselves, except for the new freddy suit, so there should be further firmware in there.
[uniform]Do you want me to extract it too?”
[uniform]Darius J. R.
“I know you told me not to, but I checked the electronics in the suits.
They just control things like the ears, the eyes, the tail... Things a regular human would not have spare arms for.
However, the freddy suit does not have this technology. It seems... different.
Not to mention it’s weight. Combined with the [uniform]endtest.7.13.c[/uniform], it is really hard to move around.
I tried turning it on, and it works fine. But when I activated the offstage mode, and it started walking
it made a really loud noise with every step. I also got some interference on my walkie-talkie.
What I’m getting at is that, if you are trying to recreate one of the finished versions
you can count with me, but I would need deeper understanding of the whole project.”
[uniform]Darius J. R.
“As you told me, I tried running some tests on the [uniform]end01fx.10.21.
I cannot tell you for sure what happened to it, but unfortunately, it is really messed up.
There are a lot of components broken or straight up missing.
Fortunately, the main processor is intact, as well as all of the electronic connections.
So given replacement parts, it could theoretically be fixed.
When I turned it on, however, it was a mess. All of the sensors were completely uncalibrated.
I could even see the infrared sensor through the foxy suit’s eye, so it is just a red sensor.
I tried flashing the sensor of the [uniform]end01fx.10.21[/uniform], and it backed up. Shortly after, it turned off on its own.
It was impossible for me to turn it back on, so this is as much of a report you are getting.
Keep the restricted mode on it, just in case.
We don’t want it turning back on and starts wandering around, now do we?”
[uniform]Darius J. R.
